illustrative_job.rule: illustration criterion v2 (D-054): over the same eligible set, sort by (declared GPU-h, job_uid) and take the first job whose cumulative declared GPU-h reaches 50% of the set's total (the GPU-hour-weighted median)
illustrative_job.disclosure: Illustration criterion v2 (D-054). The §11 rule (the job nearest the median GPU-hours of the 383,515 eligible flexible jobs with a feasible remote action) selects 6007181#c2 (SFT, 1 GPUs, 203 s, 0.0564 GPU-h), because that set's median is only 0.0564 GPU-h. The story uses the GPU-hour-weighted median instead: the eligible jobs sorted by (declared GPU-h, job_uid), and the first whose cumulative declared GPU-h reaches 50% of the set's 3,537,127 GPU-h, which is 5930563#c3 (Pretrain, 72 GPUs, 103.6 h, 7,461.3 GPU-h). The criterion was registered after the literal rule's choice was seen and before the test window opened; the literal-rule job is exported as illustrative_job_literal. Neither example replaces the cohort aggregate.
